parameters.query:
-- messages.location_id is a foreign key. The failure payload usually
-- carries the real location; when it does not, the call row (or the failure
-- itself) is the only handle, so fall back to the default location from the
-- instance environment before giving up on a placeholder.
INSERT INTO locations (location_id, business_name, timezone, calendar_id)
VALUES ($1, 'Unknown practice (booking failure)', 'America/New_York', '')
ON CONFLICT (location_id) DO NOTHING;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify([$json.call_id, $json.location_id || $env.DEFAULT_LOCATION_ID || 'booking-failure', $json.phone, 'BOOKING FAILED (' + $json.code + ') for caller ' + $json.phone + ($json.agent_should_say ? '. Caller was told: ' + $json.agent_should_say : '')]) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: ':rotating_light: *Booking failed* — caller believes they are booked.
• Number: ' + $json.phone + '
• Code: ' + $json.code + '
• Retryable: ' + $json.retryable + ($json.agent_should_say ? '
• Caller was told: ' + $json.agent_should_say : '') }) }}
